description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Snow)] and [Ice Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Snow)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Ice abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Iron Determination Mode] and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Snow)], removes [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Snow)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Iron Determination Mode
description.text: Casts Dual Ice Ruination when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Dual Ice Ruination
description.text: Four single attacks (0.75 each), followed by one single attack (4.45) that ignores DEF with 100% additional critical chance if the user has Dual Steel Nerves level 1+, causes Dual Steel Nerves-1 to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Snow)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Ice abilities, casts Dual Solid Wall after using Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Solid Wall
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1], grants Dual Steel Nerves +1 (max 3) to the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
